options.content: Pilots: Live now · Traffic · New pilots · Origins · **Records** · Routes · Aircraft · Military | ATC: Overview · Retention · Hours · Positions · Ranks | Events: Live events · Monday events | Management: Monthly · Health **Live data since ${go_live}; earlier history was imported.** Flights from 24-08-2025 to 06-03-2026 and controller sessions from 24-08-2025 to 15-03-2026 come from the previous system (no speed, altitude or SELCAL for imported flights). There are no flights after 06-03-2026 and no controller sessions after 15-03-2026 until ${go_live}. Panels for the last 7 or 30 days and the live tables show current data only. All times are UTC. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position; a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight). Pilot hours are airborne hours. Each panel has fixed periods and a fixed number of rows, stated in its description; the page has no inputs.

panels.title: Which member spent the most time online? (last 7 days)
panels.description: Question A1 (v1 card 155), copied unchanged from Pilots: traffic and aircraft. Definition: the ten pilots whose name has a Y as its fourth character from the end (names ending in a home airport code such as YSSY; the v1 rule) with the most airborne hours over flights that finished in the last 7 days and had more than 30 minutes airborne, in whole hours. Despite the title the figure is airborne time, not time online. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH flight_summaries AS (
  -- v3 stand-in for the v1 table: one row per flight
  SELECT cid, name, logon_time,
         end_time AS completion_time,
         airborne_minutes AS total_enroute_time_minutes,
         duration_minutes AS time_online_minutes
  FROM flight
)
SELECT
    cid,
    name,
    ROUND(SUM(total_enroute_time_minutes) / 60.0) AS total_enroute_hours
FROM flight_summaries
WHERE
    SUBSTRING(name FROM LENGTH(name) - 3 FOR 1) = 'Y'
    AND total_enroute_time_minutes > 30
    AND completion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY cid, name
ORDER BY SUM(total_enroute_time_minutes) DESC, cid
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Pilots with the most flights (last 30 days)
panels.description: Question A2 (new). Definition: the ten pilots with the most flights that finished in the last 30 days, flights with airborne time only (a parked flight, with none, is not counted), one row per pilot, name as on their latest flight, ties broken by lower CID. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (array_agg(f.name ORDER BY f.end_time DESC))[1] AS "Pilot",
       count(*) AS "Flights"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
  AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
GROUP BY f.cid
ORDER BY count(*) DESC, f.cid
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Pilots with the most diverse routes (last 14 days)
panels.description: Question A3 (v1 card 46), copied unchanged from Pilots: traffic and aircraft. Definition: the ten pilots with the most distinct routes (departure-arrival) over flights that finished in the last 14 days, counting only flights over 60 minutes online and not ZZZZ. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (array_agg(f.name ORDER BY f.end_time DESC))[1] AS pilot,
       count(DISTINCT route_label) AS unique_routes,
       count(*) AS total_flights
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.duration_minutes > 60
  AND NOT f.is_zzzz
GROUP BY f.cid
ORDER BY unique_routes DESC, total_flights DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Longest flights (last 30 days)
panels.description: Question A4 (new). Definition: the ten flights with the most airborne hours among flights that finished in the last 30 days (airborne hours, not time connected; flights with airborne time only, so no 0.0 hour rows), with pilot, callsign, route and finish time (UTC). Ties: the later finish first. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.name AS "Pilot", f.callsign AS "Callsign", f.route_label AS "Route",
       round(f.airborne_minutes / 60.0, 1) AS "Airborne hours",
       to_char(f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI') AS "Finished (UTC)"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
  AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
ORDER BY f.airborne_minutes DESC, f.end_time DESC, f.session_id
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Flights finished per week
panels.description: Question A5 (new). Definition: the number of flights per calendar week (Monday 00:00 UTC to Sunday 23:59 UTC), over the last 12 months, by the week the flight finished in. Flights with airborne time only (a parked flight, with none, is not counted); weeks with no flights show 0. The week in progress is partial. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('week', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'),
                         date_trunc('week', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), interval '1 week') AS wk
)
SELECT w.wk AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time, count(f.session_id) AS "flights"
FROM w
LEFT JOIN flight_ext f ON f.airborne_minutes > 0 AND f.end_time >= w.wk AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AND f.end_time < (w.wk + interval '1 week') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
GROUP BY w.wk
ORDER BY w.wk

panels.title: Active pilots and controllers (last 90 days, log scale)
panels.description: Question A6 (v1 card 93), copied unchanged from Demographics: pilot origins and cohorts. Definition: the Pilots bar is the number of distinct pilots with at least 30 minutes airborne in a flight that finished in the last 90 days; the other bars are controllers by rating and are not part of this question. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label, people FROM (
  SELECT -100 AS sort, 'Pilots' AS label, count(DISTINCT f.cid) AS people
  FROM flight_ext f
  WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND f.airborne_minutes >= 30
  UNION ALL
  SELECT min(r.rating) AS sort, r.label, count(DISTINCT r.cid) AS people
  FROM (
    SELECT c.rating, c.cid,
           CASE c.rating WHEN 1 THEN 'Obs' WHEN 2 THEN 'S1' WHEN 3 THEN 'S2' WHEN 4 THEN 'S3' WHEN 5 THEN 'C1'
                         WHEN 6 THEN 'C2' WHEN 7 THEN 'C3' WHEN 8 THEN 'I1' WHEN 9 THEN 'I2' WHEN 10 THEN 'I3'
                         WHEN 11 THEN 'Supervisor' WHEN 12 THEN 'Administrator' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS label
    FROM controller_session_ranked c
    WHERE (c.session_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() OR c.session_end BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo())
      AND c.duration_minutes >= 30
  ) r
  GROUP BY r.label
) x
ORDER BY sort

panels.title: Average flight length (7 days, 30 days, since go-live)
panels.description: Question A10 (new). Definition: the average airborne time of flights that finished in the period and had airborne time (a flight with none, such as one parked and never moved, has no length and is left out), for the last 7 days and 30 days ending now and since go-live on 07-10-2026. The figure is airborne minutes and hours, not time connected. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w(label, ord, since) AS (
  VALUES ('Last 7 days', 1, now() - interval '7 days'), ('Last 30 days', 2, now() - interval '30 days'), ('Since go-live', 3, NULL::timestamptz)
)
SELECT w.label AS "Period",
       count(f.session_id) AS "Flights with airborne time",
       round(avg(f.airborne_minutes), 1) AS "Average airborne minutes",
       round(avg(f.airborne_minutes) / 60.0, 2) AS "Average airborne hours"
FROM w
LEFT JOIN flight_ext f ON f.airborne_minutes > 0 AND (w.since IS NULL OR f.end_time >= w.since)
GROUP BY w.label, w.ord
ORDER BY w.ord

panels.title: Busiest days by flights (last 6 months)
panels.description: Question A7 (v1 card 128), copied unchanged from Pilots: traffic and aircraft. Definition: the five UTC dates with the most flights, by the date the flight started, over the last 6 months (180 days). A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (f.start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS flight_date,
       trim(to_char(f.start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'Day')) AS day_name,
       count(*) AS total_flights
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.start_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY total_flights DESC, flight_date DESC
LIMIT 5

panels.title: Busiest days by pilots online (last 6 months)
panels.description: Question A8 (v1 card 129), copied unchanged from Pilots: traffic and aircraft. Definition: the ten UTC dates with the most distinct pilots, by the date the pilot logged on, over the last 6 months (180 days), with weekday and rank. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS member_date,
       trim(to_char(f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'Day')) AS day_name,
       count(DISTINCT f.cid) AS unique_pilots,
       row_number() OVER (ORDER BY count(DISTINCT f.cid) DESC, (f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date DESC) AS rank
FROM flight f
WHERE f.logon_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY unique_pilots DESC, member_date DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: When are people online on weekdays (last 30 days)
panels.description: Question A9 (v1 card 94), copied unchanged from Pilots: online now. Definition: for each UTC clock hour, the number of distinct callsigns online at some point in that hour over the last 30 days, Monday to Friday (by the day the flight or session started): pilots with airborne time, and ATC sessions of at least 20 minutes. A count over the whole period, not an average of people online at once. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
-- v1 card 94: callsigns online in each UTC clock hour over the last 30 days.
WITH flight_hours AS (
    SELECT f.callsign,
           generate_series(
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int,
               CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int >= EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int THEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int ELSE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int + 24 END
           ) % 24 AS active_hour
    FROM flight f
    WHERE f.end_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
      AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
      AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') BETWEEN 1 AND 5
      AND f.logon_time IS NOT NULL
      AND f.end_time IS NOT NULL
),
atc_hours AS (
    SELECT cs.callsign,
           generate_series(
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM cs.session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int,
               CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM COALESCE(cs.session_end_time, now()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int >= EXTRACT(HOUR FROM cs.session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int THEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM COALESCE(cs.session_end_time, now()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int ELSE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM COALESCE(cs.session_end_time, now()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int + 24 END
           ) % 24 AS active_hour
    FROM controller_summaries cs
    WHERE (cs.session_start_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
           OR cs.session_end_time >= now() - interval '30 days')
      AND cs.session_duration_minutes >= 20
      AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM cs.session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') BETWEEN 1 AND 5
      AND cs.session_start_time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COALESCE(fh.active_hour, ah.active_hour)::int AS hour_utc,
       COALESCE(fh.n, 0) AS "Pilots (callsigns)",
       COALESCE(ah.n, 0) AS "ATC (callsigns)"
FROM (SELECT active_hour, COUNT(DISTINCT callsign) AS n FROM flight_hours GROUP BY active_hour) fh
FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT active_hour, COUNT(DISTINCT callsign) AS n FROM atc_hours GROUP BY active_hour) ah
  ON fh.active_hour = ah.active_hour
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: When are people online on weekends (last 30 days)
panels.description: Question A9 (v1 card 95), copied unchanged from Pilots: online now. Definition: for each UTC clock hour, the number of distinct callsigns online at some point in that hour over the last 30 days, Saturday and Sunday: pilots with airborne time, and ATC sessions of at least 30 minutes. A flight or session that crosses midnight is not counted in the hours after midnight (as v1). A count over the whole period, not an average. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
-- v1 card 95: callsigns online in each UTC clock hour over the last 30 days.
WITH flight_hours AS (
    SELECT f.callsign,
           generate_series(
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int,
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int
           ) AS active_hour
    FROM flight f
    WHERE f.end_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
      AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
      AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') IN (6, 7)
      AND f.logon_time IS NOT NULL
      AND f.end_time IS NOT NULL
),
atc_hours AS (
    SELECT cs.callsign,
           generate_series(
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM cs.session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int,
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM COALESCE(cs.session_end_time, now()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int
           ) AS active_hour
    FROM controller_summaries cs
    WHERE (cs.session_start_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
           OR cs.session_end_time >= now() - interval '30 days')
      AND cs.session_duration_minutes >= 30
      AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM cs.session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') IN (6, 7)
      AND cs.session_start_time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COALESCE(fh.active_hour, ah.active_hour)::int AS hour_utc,
       COALESCE(fh.n, 0) AS "Pilots (callsigns)",
       COALESCE(ah.n, 0) AS "ATC (callsigns)"
FROM (SELECT active_hour, COUNT(DISTINCT callsign) AS n FROM flight_hours GROUP BY active_hour) fh
FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT active_hour, COUNT(DISTINCT callsign) AS n FROM atc_hours GROUP BY active_hour) ah
  ON fh.active_hour = ah.active_hour
ORDER BY 1
